entities.summary: Neguri Gane is a 148 meter-skyscraper located in Benidorm, Spain. The 43 story building began construction in 1998, and was completed in 2002. Upon completion it was Benidorm's tallest building, having since been overtaken by the Torre Lúgano, Gran Hotel Bali, and Intempo. The building was completed in the brutalist style. It is named after the Neguri neighborhood of Getxo, in the Basque Country of Spain. It is the 14th tallest building in Spain.
